{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load and clean data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders and refunded orders
completed_only = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue'] != 999999.99)]

# Check for confounding: cross-tabulate channel and customer_segment
tab = pd.crosstab(completed_only['channel'], completed_only['customer_segment'])
print('Cross-tabulation of channel vs customer_segment:\n', tab)

# Compute conversion rate by channel
conv_rate_email = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].mean()
conv_rate_paid_search = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference
diff = conv_rate_email - conv_rate_paid_search

print('\nConversion rate (email):', conv_rate_email)
print('Conversion rate (paid_search):', conv_rate_paid_search)
print('Difference (email - paid_search):', diff)

# Output for report
print('\n--- Summary for report ---')
print(f'Conversion rate (email): {conv_rate_email:.4f}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {conv_rate_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {diff:.4f}')"}
